title: hermione italica var. princeps
intro: Hermione italica var. princeps, commonly known as Italian wormwood, is a plant species in the mint family Lamiaceae. It is primarily used for its therapeutic properties, particularly in traditional medicine. Italian wormwood has been reported to possess several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can aid in reducing fever, relieving pain, and protecting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Italian wormwood include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antispasmodic, carminative, and anti-inflammatory properties.
